newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firm, January/March spread cited.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firm, January/March spread cited.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher with much of the day's volume derived from trading in the January/March spread, traders said.
Fundamentals were little changed, they said.
"Funds rolled from the January (rolled Jan long positions) into the March..they were buying March and selling Jan," a trader said.
But there were indications a commercial interest took the other side of the spread and was buying the January and selling March, they said. "LIT sold March and bought Jan on a scale up," he said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 400 contracts, below the 522 traded Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed three to five cents per cwt higher, with January up five at $10.66 per cwt.
